dedupe_keys.name: tunisian transport sector open data portal data transport tn

description: The sectoral open data portal of the Tunisian Ministry of Transport gathers 136 datasets from the ministry and state transport operators on a CKAN catalogue. Publishers include Tunis transport company TRANSTU, the national railway SNCFT, regional bus companies of Sfax, Kairouan, Jendouba, Nabeul, Bizerte, Médenine, Béja and Kef, the interurban bus company SNTRI, Tunisair, the Kerkennah ferry company, the navigation company CTN, the merchant navy and ports office OMMP, the civil aviation and airports office OACA, the land transport agency ATTT, the Sfax light metro company and the national meteorology institute INM. Datasets include a national stop register, GTFS-style tables (routes, trips, stops, stop times, shapes), bus and TGM station positions, railway lines and level crossings by region, commercial ports and port specifications, airports and runways, daily flight status, timetables, fleets and passenger statistics, and INM seismic and synoptic station networks and climate projections. Formats include CSV. Access is free with no registration, and the routes dataset shows the OTL licence. Caveats: many datasets are simple lists, update dates vary (many were refreshed in January 2026), and the portal is in French and Arabic. Coverage is Tunisia. It supports network flow and capacity planning across road, rail, maritime and air transport, and hazard exposure of stations and level crossings; related records are the Niš public transport GTFS and the Croatian transport registers.
